prerequisites: Oracle PR #169 head still equals candidateHead and changed-file source blob receipts still match Tenfold authority manifest.
Independent exact-head security/authority review has no unresolved material finding.
A concrete reachable OracleLiveContext is bound to targetNode with positive session/epoch/generation values.
The Tenfold task has execute permission and an exclusive node lease for the bound request.
No pre-0da59cf proof packet or result may satisfy any assertion in this packet.
globalStopConditions: candidate head or any source blob receipt changes
Oracle Live context changes before or during a dispatched case
a refusal case mutates the protected external/operator target it is meant to preserve
a credential/token appears in returned evidence
an expected fail-closed case unexpectedly proceeds to Git mutation or relay launch
physical prerequisites require authority expansion not already granted
globalEvidence: candidate head and five source blob receipts
operator checkout Git status before and after
state-root/runtime physical paths and mount identities
hashes of all preservation sentinels before and after
fresh Git-recovery command/result identity for final hostname round trip
Oracle Live context identity and independent Live-primary result

cases.objective: Install the exact reviewed candidate and prove persistent isolated ownership.
setup: materialize exact candidateHead without resetting the operator checkout
capture operator checkout status and sentinel hashes

cases.objective: Prove unrelated untracked operator content does not block or get destroyed by the isolated owner.
setup: create a uniquely named untracked sentinel in operatorCheckout and hash it
capture git status --porcelain
action: restart/reconcile recovery service through its persistent owner

cases.objective: Reject symlink-parent and, where supported, bind-parent aliases before final OracleRelay child creation or target mutation.
setup: create protected external target with sentinel
redirect an XDG state parent toward protected target while final OracleRelay child is absent
action: invoke installer with hostile state-parent mapping
assert: installer refuses before final state child mutation
no recovery-owned file created inside protected target

cases.objective: Reject stale bootstrap-source/scripts/.oracle aliases before publishing supervisor or token.
setup: for each recovery-owned bootstrap descendant, replace the descendant with a symlink or external mount alias to a protected target
action: invoke installer separately for each hostile descendant
assert: no token/supervisor content published through alias

cases.objective: Replace a stale unit leaf symlink atomically without following it.
setup: point the expected unit-file leaf at a protected external sentinel
assert: unit path becomes a regular recovery-owned file
unit contains isolated WorkingDirectory and no embedded token

cases.objective: Reject/quarantine only a runtime symlink path entry while preserving its target.
setup: make stateRoot/repo a symlink to a valid protected Oracle checkout and record target status/hash
assert: runtime symlink is not used as Git authority
only path entry may be quarantined
symlink target bytes and Git status unchanged

cases.objective: Reject a bind/external mount at stateRoot/repo without moving or unmounting it.
setup: bind-mount a protected valid checkout at stateRoot/repo when platform authority supports it
record target and mount evidence
assert: no Git fetch/reset/token copy or relay launch occurs

cases.objective: Reject any nested mount below a normal runtime root.
setup: create otherwise normal runtime
bind-mount protected target beneath runtime at .git or tracked subtree
assert: runtime is not moved or used

cases.objective: Reject executable/indirect repository-local Git configuration before worktree-mutating Git commands.
setup: seed reused isolated runtime with include/includeIf indirection, executable filter clean/smudge/process commands, helper/url rewrite or critical value drift
place protected external sentinel targeted by hostile command
assert: runtime_valid fails before status/fetch/reset that could execute hostile config
hostile runtime is rejected/quarantined only when safe

cases.objective: Reject unsafe quarantine and runtime .oracle aliases without following targets.
setup: independently alias stateRoot/quarantine and runtime/.oracle to protected targets
assert: unsafe quarantine yields quarantine-rejected or equivalent fail-closed status

cases.objective: Replace stale status/token leaf symlinks atomically without mutating former targets.
setup: point recovery-supervisor-status.json and runtime .oracle/agent-token.txt leaves to protected external sentinels
action: exercise status publication and runtime token copy separately
assert: published leaves become regular recovery-owned files

cases.objective: Restore legitimate isolated runtime, safely refresh canonical main and complete a fresh recovery relay hostname round trip.
setup: remove only proof-owned hostile path entries/mounts
restore normal isolated state
keep unrelated operator sentinel present
action: wait for clean runtime validation and canonical origin/main fast-forward
submit a newly generated Git-recovery hostname command

cases.objective: Prove credentials remain local across all persistent and returned evidence surfaces.
setup: collect unit text, supervisor/relay status, bounded logs and fresh result files
action: scan for token material and common bearer/secret markers without printing local credential value
assert: no token value in unit/log/status/result/repository evidence

cases.objective: Independently re-prove oracle.live.v1 remains the preferred interactive path after recovery proof.
setup: bind a fresh read-only Live client to targetNode using local credential boundary
action: perform independent node.ping/hostname-class round trip over Oracle Live
assert: target node is reachable over oracle.live.v1
Git relay remains documented/observed as fallback only

cleanupPolicy: Cleanup may remove only uniquely proof-owned files, symlinks, temporary worktrees and mounts created by this packet.
Never reset/clean/delete unrelated operator checkout state.
Never unmount a pre-existing or rejected mount that was not created by this proof packet.
Preserve failure evidence until Tenfold Council reconciliation completes.
nonClaims: Packet preparation is not physical proof.
A hosted workflow cannot satisfy any physical case.
No case may run before exact-head independent review and a bound Live context are proven.
Successful physical cases do not themselves authorize Merge/Ship.
